title.en: To be only / to merely ~ (-(으)ㄹ 뿐이다)

sentences.target: -(으)ㄹ 뿐이다는 어떤 상태나 행동이 '그것뿐임'을 강조할 때 사용한다.
sentences.en: The form -(으)ㄹ 뿐이다 is used to emphasize that something is ‘nothing more than’ what is stated.

sentences.target: 말하는 사람이 상황의 규모나 의미를 축소하여 표현하는 느낌을 준다.
sentences.en: It gives the nuance that the speaker is downplaying the scale or meaning of the situation.

sentences.target: '단지 ~할 뿐이다', '그저 ~일 뿐이다'와 같은 의미로 이해하면 쉽다.
sentences.en: It is similar to saying “I only ~,” “It’s just ~,” or “It was merely ~.”

sentences.target: 주관적인 해석이나 감정을 담아 설명할 때 자연스럽다.
sentences.en: It is natural when expressing a subjective view or personal feeling.

sentences.target: 긍정적·부정적 상황 모두에서 사용할 수 있다.
sentences.en: It can be used in both positive and negative contexts.

sentences.target: 주로 사실을 강조하기보다는 화자의 태도나 관점을 드러낸다.
sentences.en: It highlights the speaker’s attitude or perspective rather than emphasizing objective facts.

sentences.target: 본래 의미보다 가볍게 말하거나 책임을 줄여 표현할 때 쓰기도 한다.
sentences.en: It can also be used to soften responsibility or make a statement sound lighter.

sentences.target: 과장된 느낌을 줄일 때도 적절하다.
sentences.en: It can reduce any exaggerated impression the listener may have.

sentences.target: 주로 문장 끝에서 화자의 결론처럼 제시된다.
sentences.en: It usually appears at the end of the sentence as the speaker’s concluding remark.

sentences.target: 문맥에 따라 겸손, 변명, 담담한 설명 등 다양한 뉘앙스로 변할 수 있다.
sentences.en: Depending on the context, it can express humility, an excuse, or a calm explanation.

sentences.target: 나는 그냥 사실을 말했을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: I only said the truth.

sentences.target: 도와준 건 작은 일일 뿐이야.
sentences.en: What I did was just a small favor.

sentences.target: 우리는 서로 오해했을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: We simply misunderstood each other.

sentences.target: 그건 단순한 실수였을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: It was merely a simple mistake.

sentences.target: 나는 내 역할을 했을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: I only did my part.

sentences.target: 그는 조언을 해 준 것뿐이야.
sentences.en: He just gave some advice, that’s all.

sentences.target: 늦어진 건 교통이 막혔을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: It was delayed because the traffic was heavy, that’s all.

sentences.target: 기분이 나쁜 게 아니라 피곤했을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: I wasn’t in a bad mood; I was just tired.

sentences.target: 화를 낸 게 아니라 놀랐을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: I wasn’t angry; I was just surprised.

sentences.target: 진심이 아니고 그냥 농담이었을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: It wasn’t serious; it was only a joke.

sentences.target: 그 말을 한 건 걱정됐을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: I said that because I was worried, that’s all.

sentences.target: 무례한 게 아니라 급했을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: I wasn’t being rude; I was just in a hurry.

sentences.target: 나는 선택지를 설명했을 뿐인데 분위기가 이상해졌어.
sentences.en: I only explained the options, but the atmosphere became awkward.

sentences.target: 그 문제는 단지 시간이 부족했을 뿐 해결 가능했어.
sentences.en: The problem was solvable; we just lacked enough time.

sentences.target: 우리는 서로 몰랐을 뿐 크게 잘못한 건 없어.
sentences.en: We simply didn’t know each other well, so there wasn’t a big mistake.

sentences.target: 그의 반응은 놀랐을 뿐 화난 게 아니었어.
sentences.en: His reaction was just surprise, not anger.

sentences.target: 내 의견은 참고용일 뿐 결정은 너에게 있어.
sentences.en: My opinion is only for reference; the decision is yours.

sentences.target: 나는 최선을 다했을 뿐 결과는 장담할 수 없어.
sentences.en: I only did my best; I can’t guarantee the result.

sentences.target: 그 프로젝트가 늦어진 건 절차가 복잡했을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: The project was delayed because the procedure was complicated, that’s all.

sentences.target: 그건 비판이 아니라 조언이었을 뿐이야.
sentences.en: It wasn’t criticism; it was only advice.
